Prefecture boundaries

Source: MLIT National Land Numerical Information, Administrative Area Data N03-2019.
国土数値情報（行政区域データ・2019年）をもとに加工しています。
https://nlftp.mlit.go.jp/ksj/gml/datalist/KsjTmplt-N03.html

GeoJSON conversion and prefecture merging:
https://github.com/piuccio/open-data-jp-prefectures-geojson
Source blob: e93570a1f48dd252192d2625b44464144700d42a

Changes for this game: simplified coordinate rings (approximately 0.007 degrees),
removed tiny offshore islets, rounded coordinates and converted to JavaScript.
Displayed geography is a simplified game map, not a survey or legal boundary map.


Display-area adaptation: the game’s simplified Natural Earth coastline is
partitioned into prefecture-owned triangles (maximum edge about 0.12 degrees),
then shared internal edges are removed. N03 determines approximate ownership;
the display coastline is preserved exactly. This is generated by
scripts/build-deformed-prefectures.mjs into deformed-prefectures.js.
Natural Earth coastline data is public domain.
